withdrawalNotice.quote:
A candidate in the race for the office of Supervisor, Lake St. Charles Community Development
District Seat 2 has withdrawn such that:


A vote cast for Yvonne Brown will count.


A vote cast for Barbara A. Kirby will not count.


A vote cast for Toni Kristina Rhodus will count.
